    Mesh corrections on a periodic star model #

    Assembly of Appendix A for a periodic component covered by a star model whose deck group is generated by g (v, t) = (ρ v, t + c₀) with ρ fixing the centre (periodic-mesh-calculations.tex): normalize the coefficients (Lemma A.1(1)), lift the rows of degree m + 1 (they exist only when c₀ ∣ m - 1), express them as twisted traces of words at the centre (Lemmas A.2 and A.4), and conclude from the vanishing of the traces.

    source

      theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.TraceAlg.trace_D_any {M : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup M] {L : Fin 3 → ℕ} (D : TraceData L M) (h2 : ∀ (m : M), m + m = 0 → m = 0) {a b c : Fin 3} (hab : a ≠ b) (hac : a ≠ c) (hbc : b ≠ c) (hLa : L a = 0) (hLb : L b = 0) {w : List (Fin 3)} (hw : 2 ≤ w.length) :
      D.tr w = 0

      Type D with any twist preserving the arm lengths: all traces of length at least two vanish (twists of a D_n with n ≥ 5 fix the long arm; for D_4 a twist fixing an arm is handled as a short-arm interchange, and a fixed-point free twist is a three-cycle).
